gitCommit.subject: Image performance: caching + on-demand resize (epic A — purses-u1lr.1) (#219)
gitCommit.body:
Image performance: caching + on-demand resize (epic A — purses-u1lr.1) (#219)

* docs(spec): image performance design (sub-project A) — caching + on-demand resize

Folds adversarial review (wf_fdebbbf1-a42): servePhotoFile owns the variant
ETag end-to-end (no If-None-Match passthrough to blob get); private,max-age=300,
must-revalidate instead of immutable (shared-tablet authz); sharp decode-bomb
guards; runtime=nodejs; persisted-variant-cache deferred to a bead.

Bead: purses-u1lr.1

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01NpkGzYgcy23jUToNwgjSw9

* docs(plan): image performance implementation plan (sub-project A)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01NpkGzYgcy23jUToNwgjSw9

* feat(images): servePhotoFile — variant ETag, max-age cache, guarded sharp resize

Owns the variant ETag end-to-end (no If-None-Match passthrough to blob get).
private,max-age=300,must-revalidate (shared-tablet authz). ?w= allowlist
{160,320,640,1280}; decode-bomb guards (limitInputPixels + source-byte ceiling);
EXIF auto-orient; generic 500. 12 tests, real sharp on real fixtures.

Bead: purses-u1lr.1

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01NpkGzYgcy23jUToNwgjSw9

* feat(images): photo URL helpers accept a width option

Bead: purses-u1lr.1

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01NpkGzYgcy23jUToNwgjSw9

* feat(images): item /file route delegates to servePhotoFile (nodejs runtime)

Bead: purses-u1lr.1

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01NpkGzYgcy23jUToNwgjSw9

* feat(images): pool /file route delegates to servePhotoFile (nodejs runtime)

Bead: purses-u1lr.1

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01NpkGzYgcy23jUToNwgjSw9

* feat(images): request per-surface widths at every photo URL build site

PHOTO_WIDTH map (card 640, poolTile 320, hero 1280, galleryTile 640) threaded
through collections/items/results/compare/triage pages, item-detail hero+gallery,
PhotoGallery, PoolPhotoGrid. next/image already lazy-loads non-priority tiles.

Bead: purses-u1lr.1

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01NpkGzYgcy23jUToNwgjSw9

* test(e2e): assert per-surface image widths (card 640, hero 1280)

Bead: purses-u1lr.1

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01NpkGzYgcy23jUToNwgjSw9

* fix(images): airtight decode-bomb guard + invariant/pool-width tests (review fold)

Whole-branch review (wf_16cceee2-403) folds:
- bounded readStreamCapped() so an unknown/mis-reported blob size can't OOM
  before the byte ceiling (Security+QA convergent minor); direct unit tests.
- test PHOTO_WIDTH subset of RESIZE_WIDTHS (was comment-only invariant).
- PoolPhotoGrid renders w=320 (pool tier render wiring; e2e only covered 640/1280).

Bead: purses-u1lr.1

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01NpkGzYgcy23jUToNwgjSw9

* docs(sync): API.md /file routes + ARCHITECTURE decision 14 (image cache/resize)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01NpkGzYgcy23jUToNwgjSw9

* chore(graphify): refresh graph for image-perf changes

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01NpkGzYgcy23jUToNwgjSw9

* test(e2e): match /file* glob so interceptors catch resized ?w= URLs

A's ?w= width param changed the image URL surface; the existing
'**/photos/**/file' route globs no longer matched '.../file?w=640', so those
requests hit the real (blob-credential-less) route in CI -> 500 -> CardImage
onError fallback -> getByRole('img') missing. Add the trailing * to all
interceptors. 34 e2e pass across tablet/phone/desktop.

Bead: purses-u1lr.1

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01NpkGzYgcy23jUToNwgjSw9
